_comment: ADCC 2026 women's -65 kg / +65 kg sourcing batch, 2026-08-19.
44 rows in the source list collapse to 28 distinct videos: a highlight reel was listed
once per bout it contains, and two IBJJF uploads appeared twice. frame_pdf.py collapses
them by video id, so the repeats are simply omitted here.
`start`/`end` are VIDEO-ABSOLUTE seconds inside the file at `url`. Leave both out when
nobody has established where the bout sits -- the whole video gets rendered and the
reader finds it, which is honest. Guessing an interval is the mislocalisation defect in
`note` carries the provenance from whoever sourced the link, verbatim. `Parcial` means
the reel was confirmed to contain the athlete but the individual bout was not.
